name: rockspec
description: PM-orchestrated change delivery: adversarial maker/checker pairing plus deterministic hooks.

interface.shortDescription: PM-orchestrated change delivery for coding agents
interface.longDescription: The main session acts as PM: it dispatches specialist agents (BA, SA, RR, Dev, CR, TE) across a two-phase PROPOSE/APPLY flow, keeps quality through adversarial checkers and deterministic hooks, and enforces a single Finish invariant instead of a hard-coded state machine.
defaultPrompt: Act as PM (rs2-pm) and orchestrate this repository change.
Clarify requirements with the BA role (rs2-ba) interactively.
Draft the technical design with the SA role (rs2-sa).
Run the deterministic hook check on this artifact before review.
